acceptanceCriteria: native_hook treats fork as resume, with a test.
body: Found by the 2026-09-27 adapter audit for rc.2. cmd/corvint/native_hook.go:167 admits only startup|resume|clear|compact, but Claude Code 2.1.267 and Codex 0.153 send fork. The host adapter path now maps fork to resume (AHI spec); the native-hook path still refuses it.
title: Qualified native-hook path refuses SessionStart source fork
